snippet.title: Zombie Tag | First Trailer
snippet.description: Zombie Tag is a multiplayer tag game where humans run from a zombie in a construction-site parkour arena. The zombie infects caught players, turning them into zombies. Push others with boxing gloves, use traps, and survive until time runs out.
